capabilities: Render contact-card code blocks as styled business cards
Populate photos from Gravatar by email address
Fetch company logos from Logo.dev by email domain
Reference vault images via wiki-links for photos and logos
Customize card styling with CSS classes and snippets
extras: Photos and logos come from third-party services; if a linked vault file is missing, the plugin silently falls back to Gravatar or Logo.dev. A roadmap lists planned social media links and richer photo lookup.
problem: Contact details stored as YAML or plain text in notes are hard to scan and lack visuals like photos and company logos.

relations.evidence: Avatars are pulled from Gravatar, based on email address.
Company logos retrieved from Logo.dev, based on email domain.
Profile Card UI by Genaro Colusso
relations.plugin: Profile Card UI by Genaro Colusso

summary: Code-block renderer that turns YAML contact data into a styled business card with photo, logo, and clickable fields.
